Put raw images here, then run: python3 build/images.py
All images are made SQUARE except banner (900x500), popup (9:16) and og. Names: see build/images.py.
  banner, popup, hero, about, app, invite, logo, og
  categories/<page key>  (casino, slots, live, sports, esports, crash, fishing, cards, lottery, instant, app, promotions, vip, referral, affiliate)
  promos/<promo image>   (promo-1, promo-2, promo-3)
  games/<slug>           (GAMES in site_config)
  providers/<lowercase-dashed provider name>  (e.g. pragmatic-play, jili)
  posts/<post key>
